concept: Nested rows that open and close, indented by level, with a turning chevron and the chosen row in the Sidebar chosen pane.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a tree view with plus and minus boxes and dotted connector lines
default_to_avoid.kind: tree view, tree, folder tree, outline
default_to_avoid.why_not: plus boxes and dotted lines are the old file manager look and add ink; Pane uses indent and a turning chevron

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the chevron points right when closed and down when open, and the chosen row is chosen glass

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: the arrow keys open, close and move between rows and typing a letter finds the next row

derivation.consequence: padding inside a pane is larger than the gap between items in it, so the edge reads as the object's boundary
derivation.form: each level is indented by one step, so nesting reads by position without lines

options: B plus boxes and dotted lines
variants.reason: A says nesting by indent and state by shape (P3, P6). B adds ink. C stacks panes in panes.

root.why: the tree is a plain list with no bullets or padding of its own

group.why: a node children sit in a nested group with the same spacing

item.why: each item takes focus itself and draws its ring on its row

row.why: each row is at least 44px tall with the chevron, icon and label in a line

chosen.why: the chosen row is the Sidebar chosen pane in semibold

chevron.why: a node with children has a chevron that turns as it opens

open.why: an open node turns its chevron a quarter turn to point down

icon.why: the icon is secondary so the label is read first

label.why: the label wraps anywhere so long names never spill

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

hover.why: a row takes the quiet surface under the pointer

focus-visible.why: the row of the focused item shows the ring inside its edges

background-color.why: the hover surface fades in on the hover ease

transform.why: the chevron turns on the hover ease as the node opens
